purpose: Non-admission discovery of four independently identified global coastal, ecosystem, station-metadata and revised seismic-catalogue products; rights, original bytes and scientific fitness remain unapproved.

entries.name: Deltares GTSM-ERA5-E global extreme sea-level statistics v2
entries.spatial_scope: Global ocean coasts and GTSM model output locations; geographic coverage and coastal point spacing require asset-level audit
entries.temporal_scope: Reanalysis model period 1950-2024; Zenodo v2 released 2025-02-25
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 9.7 MB NetCDF statistics ds_GTSM-ERA5-E_1950-2024_stats.nc; percentiles and 1, 2, 5, 10, 25, 50, 75 and 100-year return levels; underlying time series are a separate Climate Data Store product
entries.note: Provider lists original NetCDF file and MD5 0f2b7071c6ec3585768be6cf427e6eab; no original SHA-256 independently verified here. This is reanalysis-driven model output, not observed flood extent/depth, a surge inundation map, a stochastic loss event set, or insurer exposure. Preserve tidal/total-level variable definitions, vertical datum, spatial coordinates, fitting method, uncertainty and historical ERA5 dependence. Check overlap/lineage with WRI Aqueduct coastal hazard and any already registered coastal models; access to CDS time series and redistribution/commercial rights are separate checks.

entries.name: JAXA Global Mangrove Watch annual mangrove extent v4.1.12
entries.provider: JAXA / Aberystwyth University / Global Mangrove Watch partners
entries.spatial_scope: Worldwide mangrove coastlines where remotely sensed mapping coverage is available
entries.temporal_scope: Annual epochs 1985-2025; v4.1.12 public release announced 2026-08-03
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 30 m binary mangrove-presence GeoTIFF; 41 annual bands; EPSG:4326; DN=1 mangrove and DN=0 non-mangrove
entries.note: JAXA documents free public use under its research-data Terms of Use with specific credit rules; exact commercial derivative, redistribution and attribution scope still require review. Satellite coverage and omission/commission error vary by place and historical epoch. Binary mangrove cover is not measured surge attenuation, flood defence height, building stock, insured value or hazard intensity; do not apply protective loss discounts without independent physical and vulnerability calibration. Check overlaps with ESA WorldCover mangrove class and source-input dependence.

entries.name: WMO OSCAR/Surface global observing-station metadata
entries.spatial_scope: Global WMO-member observing stations and platforms represented in OSCAR/Surface
entries.temporal_scope: Continuously updated station metadata; research snapshot to be pinned in 2026
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Station and instrument capability/variable metadata keyed by WIGOS Station Identifier; live registry with no frozen dataset release here
entries.note: Official WMO documentation identifies OSCAR/Surface as the authoritative station/platform observation-capability metadata registry, not the underlying wind, rain or temperature observation time series. Before retrieval pin API/version, lawful allowed request, WIGOS ID normalization, station effective date, relocation history and licence. Exclude personal/contact fields and disallow unrestricted bulk harvest. Do not infer spatial observation coverage or measured extremes from registration alone; assess correspondence with NOAA GHCN and national networks.

entries.name: ISC-GEM Global Instrumental Earthquake Catalogue v13.0
entries.spatial_scope: Global instrumental earthquake catalogue with magnitude- and epoch-dependent completeness
entries.temporal_scope: Version 13.0 released 2026-10-21; includes revised historical earthquakes and data through the end of 2022
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Provider CSV main and supplementary catalogues; historical reassessment of 2,762 events in 1940-1963, with 1,070 newly listed, and 1,755 events at Mw down to 5.0 for 2022
entries.note: Supersedes existing non-admission candidate isc-gem.global-instrumental-earthquake-catalogue.v12.1; preserve both identities and compare original event IDs/relocations/magnitude uncertainties before an event-table version switch. Provider states CC BY-SA 3.0; commercial deployment, derived databases and redistribution require specific ShareAlike/legal review. A magnitude- and region-dependent earthquake catalogue is not an occurrence-rate model, complete small-event set, ground-motion field or insured loss. No provider bytes acquired or SHA-256 verified in this contribution.
